This rented bean plot is small, only about one-seventh of a hectare, so I will not buy fertilizer or improved seed for it—beans grow well enough with my own saved seed and the soil's natural strength. My wife and I can manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves over the season, so I see no reason to spend money hiring workers.
